title: Menswork theme in the theme library: Hearts on Fire fonts on the Space page and the full look on the Space website

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-07 16:27: 'I want to build a theme called Menswork for the theme library... completely style every element of the website.' Built from the Hearts on Fire Design System upload. Code only, no Space or data.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. THE CONSEQUENCE: the theme library had six page themes, all fonts only, so no Space could give its website a distinct look; Hearts on Fire needs its own. THE FIX: 'menswork' joins SPACE_THEMES (Sofia Sans Extra Condensed caps over Barlow, mono eyebrows; fonts load in app/layout.tsx with preload off like the other theme faces). On the Space page it is fonts like every theme. On the Space's website (components/sites/site-page.tsx) it also brings its palette and shapes: lib/theme/menswork.ts holds the color data (charcoal neutrals, teal, four season accents) and re-points the DAWN tokens inside the site root, so kit components and plain-band Space blocks follow; components/sites/menswork-css.ts restyles every house section (one 60 degree chamfered corner, hairlines and no shadows, no gradients or blur, condensed caps headlines, mono labels and numerals, left-aligned). The owner's own brand accent still replaces the teal. components/sites/menswork-css.test.ts fails if a house class gains a look the skin does not answer. FOLLOW-UP 2026-10-07 (owner's updated design system, HANDOFF.md): seasons turn on the solstice and equinox lines (winter Dec 21 to Mar 19, spring Mar 20 to Jun 20, summer Jun 21 to Sep 21, fall Sep 22 to Dec 20); the photography rule 'set type above the image, never over the men' moves the website hero's copy above a full-width photo instead of over a washed one, drops the photo behind the closing band, and leaves photos unfiltered; motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion. FOLLOW-UP 2 2026-10-07 (owner: 'build a theme for theheartonfire.com out of the design system, just like danieltyack.com'): the skin now follows the design's Home layout, not only its palette: the steps section is the member path (interlocking 60 degree chevrons with the number inside), facts are the five-beat chevron strip, the who section's lines are the hairline feature grid, eyebrows carry the teal chevron, headline accents are teal; a season bar under the header (season now in its accent, the year's four as a track) and a footer with the name, tagline and page links; the Space logo sits beside the name, drawn in the theme's text colour. A DAWN token accent now wears the theme teal (a token resolved against Frequency's palette above the site root).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const t=fs.readFileSync('lib/theme/space-themes.ts','utf8');const p=fs.readFileSync('components/sites/site-page.tsx','utf8');if(!/id: 'menswork'/.test(t)||!/mensworkAccentVars/.test(p)||!fs.existsSync('components/sites/menswork-css.ts')){console.error('LIVE-841: no Menswork theme, or the website does not wear it');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails on main (no Menswork theme); passes once this lands.
